findings.issue: Hiphil 3ms clothes him (אתו) with (את H854) the robe. 'lo vistió el manto' drops that preposition, so the robe reads as the subject rather than what he clothes him with.
Construct חשב plus definite האפד is the definite band of the ephod; 'cinturón' is bare.
The clause has לו ('to him') and no את object. Accusative 'lo' duplicates 'a él' unless read only as clitic doubling.

notes: The other qal clauses, articles, and בו as 'en él' stay inside the tokens.
